items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: there was another trumpet player named Louis Bacon that used to sing with Louis Armstrong. He was a ballad singer with Louis Armstrong. He got the job.

ctx.x: Better than Satchmo. So anyway Edmond Hall said really? So anyway they sent for me to come up here. The bus fare was fifteen dollars from Pensacola, Florida to New York. It came. And when it came, for some reason I didn’t get the job. I’d been trying to say to myself, I’d played with him a couple of times, but I think there was another trumpet player named Louis Bacon that used to sing with Louis Armstrong. He was a ballad singer with Louis Armstrong. He got the job. But the next thing, I wound up with one of the…
